name: Sheet Pan Shrimp Fajitas with Tomato, Avocado, Cilantro & Lime

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 orange bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
3 tomatoes
1 ½ limes
1 ½ avocados
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, mix together the spices; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips; transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and thinly slice onions into half rings; transfer both to the bowl with the peppers.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Add oil and approximately ⅔ of the spice mixture to the bowl with the veggies; toss to combine. Divide veggies between 2 large baking sheet pans; place in the oven and bake until slightly soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, transfer shrimp to the bowl used for the veggies. Add more oil and remaining spice mix; toss to coat and set aside.
Medium dice tomatoes and slice limes into wedges. Transfer both to a plate.
Halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out; add to the plate.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Remove veggies from the oven and toss. Layer shrimp on top and return to the oven; bake until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 8-10 more minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide shrimp and veggies between plates and garnish with cilantro. Serve with tortillas, tomato, avocado, yogurt, and lime wedges. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
